info.name: MRO Cars API
info.description: Complete API documentation for the MRO Cars Backend (AdonisJS). Covers Admin, User, and Business modules.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin panel API endpoints. All routes (except login) require admin auth + role.

request.description: Authenticates an admin user and returns a JWT access token plus refresh token.
